defs.def: A significant risk, undertaken with a potential gain.
A risky venture.
defs.example: The sailors had taken many gambles with the sea and always won.

defs.def: Recognition of importance or value; respect; veneration (of someone, usually for being morally upright or successful)
defs.example: The crowds gave the returning general much honor and praise.

defs.def: The state of being morally upright, honest, noble, virtuous, and magnanimous; excellence of character; the perception of such a state; favourable reputation; dignity
defs.example: He was a most perfect knight, for he had great honor and chivalry.

defs.def: A token of praise or respect; something that represents praiseworthiness or respect, such as a prize or award given by the state to a citizen
defs.example: Audie Murphy received many honors, such as the Distinguished Service Cross.

defs.def: A privilege
defs.example: I had the honour of dining with the ambassador.

defs.def: (in the plural) the privilege of going first
defs.example: I'll let you have the honours, Bob—go ahead.

defs.def: A cause of respect and fame; a glory; an excellency; an ornament.
defs.example: He is an honour to his nation.

defs.def: (feudal law) a seigniory or lordship held of the king, on which other lordships and manors depended
The center point of the upper half of an armorial escutcheon (compare honour point)
In bridge, an ace, king, queen, jack, or ten especially of the trump suit. In some other games, an ace, king, queen or jack.
(in the plural) (courses for) an honours degree: a university qualification of the highest rank
defs.example: At university I took honours in modern history.

defs.def: The act of conducting or carrying out (business, negotiations, plans).
defs.example: The transaction was made on Friday with the supplier.

defs.def: A deal or business agreement.
An exchange or trade, as of ideas, money, goods, etc.
defs.example: I made the transaction with the vendor as soon as she showed me the pearls.

defs.def: The transfer of funds into, out of, or from an account.
An atomic operation; a message, data modification, or other procedure that is guaranteed to perform completely or not at all (e.g. a database transaction).
(especially in plural) A record of the proceedings of a learned society.
(in transactional analysis) A social interaction.
A small piece broken from a larger piece of solid material.
A damaged area of a surface where a small piece has been broken off.
defs.example: This cup has a chip in it.

defs.def: (games) A token used in place of cash.
A sovereign (the coin).
A circuit fabricated in one piece on a small, thin substrate.
A hybrid device mounted in a substrate, containing electronic circuitry and miniaturised mechanical, chemical and/or biochemical devices.
(especially in the plural) A fried strip of potato of square or rectangular cross-section; a french fry.
defs.example: Do you want sauce or mayonnaise on your chips?

defs.def: (especially in the plural) A thin, crisp, fried slice of potato, or sometimes another vegetable; a crisp.
A shot during which the ball travels more predominantly upwards than in a regular shot, as to clear an obstacle.
A takeout that hits a rock at an angle.
A dried piece of dung, often used as fuel.
(northern) A receptacle, usually for strawberries or other fruit.
A small, near-conical piece of food added in baking.
A small rectangle of colour printed on coated paper for colour selection and matching. A virtual equivalent in software applications.
The triangular piece of wood attached to the log line.
Wood or Cuban palm leaf split into slips, or straw plaited in a special manner, for making hats or bonnets.
Anything dried up, withered, or without flavour.
A low shot that travels further along the ground than it does in the air.
Inclination towards something; predisposition, partiality, prejudice, preference, predilection.
The diagonal line between warp and weft in a woven fabric.
A wedge-shaped piece of cloth taken out of a garment (such as the waist of a dress) to diminish its circumference.
A voltage or current applied to an electronic device, such as a transistor electrode, to move its operating point to a desired part of its transfer function.
The difference between the expectation of the sample estimator and the true population value, which reduces the representativeness of the estimator by systematically distorting it.

In the games of crown green bowls and lawn bowls: a weight added to one side of a bowl so that as it rolls, it will follow a curved rather than a straight path; the oblique line followed by such a bowl; the lopsided shape or structure of such a bowl. In lawn bowls, the curved course is caused only by the shape of the bowl. The use of weights is prohibited.
A person's favourite member of a K-pop band.
A person or thing who enjoys special regard or favour.
defs.example: The teacher's favourite always went first.

defs.def: A person who is preferred or trusted above all others.
A contestant or competitor thought most likely to win.
defs.example: She's the favourite, she'll probably be elected.

defs.def: A bookmark in a web browser.
(in the plural) A short curl dangling over the temples, fashionable in the reign of Charles II.
A person living on adjacent or nearby land; a person situated adjacently or nearby; anything (of the same type of thing as the subject) in an adjacent or nearby position.
defs.example: My neighbour has two noisy cats.

defs.def: One who is near in sympathy or confidence.
A fellow human being.
The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.
defs.example: Our neighborhood was our only reason to exchange hollow greetings.

defs.def: Close proximity, nearby area; particularly, close proximity to one's home.
defs.example: He lives in my neighborhood.

defs.def: The inhabitants of a residential area.
defs.example: The fire alarmed the neighborhood.

defs.def: A formal or informal division of a municipality or region.
defs.example: We have just moved to a pleasant neighborhood.

defs.def: An approximate amount.
defs.example: He must be making in the neighborhood of $200,000 per year.

defs.def: The quality of physical proximity.
defs.example: The slums and the palace were in awful neighborhood.

defs.def: The disposition becoming a neighbor; neighborly kindness or good will.
Within a topological space:
Within a metric space:
The infinitesimal open set of all points that may be reached directly from a given point.
The set of all the vertices adjacent to a given vertex.
A lover of something.
A person attached to a particular pursuit, study, or science as to music or painting; especially one who cultivates any study or art, from taste or attachment, without pursuing it professionally.
defs.example: The contest is only open to amateurs.

defs.def: Someone who is unqualified or insufficiently skillful.
defs.example: The entire thing was built by some amateurs with screwdrivers and plywood.

defs.def: (degree) By a small margin.
(degree) Almost not at all.
defs.example: The plane is so far away now I can barely see it.

defs.def: Merely.
An alarm.
A notification of higher importance than an advisory.
A state of readiness for potential combat.
defs.example: an airborne alert; ground alert

defs.def: The act of stealing property.
An ethnic person, especially a foreigner or member of an immigrant community.
An ethnic minority.
A heathen, a pagan.
(in classical scholarship) the demonym of an Ancient Greek city
To do (something good) after (something bad) happens
To pay or reward someone in exchange for work done or some other consideration.
defs.example: It is hard work, but they will compensate you well for it.

defs.def: To make up for; to do something in place of something else; to correct, satisfy; to reach an agreement such that the scales are literally or (metaphorically) balanced; to equalize or make even.
defs.example: His loud voice cannot compensate for a lack of personality.

defs.def: To adjust or adapt to a change, often a harm or deprivation.
defs.example: I don't like driving that old car because it always steers a little to the left so I'm forever compensating for that when I drive it. Trust me, it gets annoying real fast.

defs.def: The act of legislating; preparation and enactment of laws; the laws enacted.
Law which has been enacted by legislature or other governing body
A debate or discussion of opposing opinions; (generally) strife.
Aid; help; the act or result of assisting.
A sight or view of the interior of anything; a deep inspection or view; introspection; frequently used with into.
Power of acute observation and deduction
Knowledge (usually derived from consumer understanding) that a company applies in order to make a product or brand perform better and be more appealing to customers
Intuitive apprehension of the inner nature of a thing or things; intuition.
An extended understanding of a subject resulting from identification of relationships and behaviors within a model, context, or scenario.
An individual's awareness of the nature and severity of one's mental illness.
A subject of a talk or an artistic piece; a topic.
A recurring idea; a motif.
An essay written for school.
The main melody of a piece of music, especially one that is the source of variations.
A song, or a snippet of a song, that identifies a film, a TV program, a character, etc. by playing at the appropriate time.
The collection of color schemes, sounds, artwork etc., that "skin" an environment towards a particular motif.
(grammar) The stem of a word.
Thematic relation of a noun phrase to a verb.
Theta role in generative grammar and government and binding theory.
Topic, what is generally being talked about, as opposed to rheme.
A regional unit of organisation in the Byzantine empire.
The action of defending or protecting from attack, danger, or injury.
Anything employed to oppose attack(s).
An argument in support or justification of something.
Government policy or (infra)structure related to the military.
defs.example: Department of Defense

defs.def: A prohibition; a prohibitory ordinance.
To make easy or easier.
To help bring about.
To preside over (a meeting, a seminar).
A company, business, organization, or other purposeful endeavor.
defs.example: A micro-enterprise is defined as a business having 5 or fewer employees and a low seed capital.

defs.def: An undertaking, venture, or project, especially a daring and courageous one.
defs.example: Biosphere 2 was a scientific enterprise aimed at the exploration of the complex web of interactions within life systems.

defs.def: A willingness to undertake new or risky projects; energy and initiative.
defs.example: He has shown great enterprise throughout his early career.

defs.def: Active participation in projects.
